title: Trace-normalized integral and rational dual-formula adjunction
statement: Fix the finite-field datum D, a prime l different from its characteristic, separated finite-type D.k-schemes X and Y, a separated finite-type morphism f:X→Y, a compactification c, a normalized exceptional coefficient system S [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], and a finite coefficient-field stage F. Supply coherent integral dualizing data wX,wY and rational Verdier data A,B [def-sf-coherent-integral-dualizing-datum, def-sf-rational-verdier-data]. Let H_I be the integral dual-pullback-dual functor using the supplied preservation fields and the prescribed completed pullback [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. There is an adjunction between rational compact support and the rational dual formula [def-sf-rational-operation-comparison-data]. Its counit is normalized as follows: there exist an ordinary derived tensor presentation aZ on c.Z and an integral compact-support/H_I adjunction such that for every integral M the identity of H_I(M) satisfies FormulaNormalized for the actual trace, completion augmentation and projection map [lem-coef-dual-formula-scalar-transpose], and the rational counit at Q(M) is heterogeneously equal to Q of this integral counit. This is a single-field construction with no exceptional-comparison isomorphism and no finite-scalar square.

source.place: lem-coef-rational-operations, original proof steps 10--11; single-field normalized adjunction only

proof.text: Use S.ring.operation at the integral stage. The full inclusion of finite-Tor integral objects is fully faithful and essentially surjective by integral_residue_tor. Its equivalence gives adjunctions on the two full integral categories. Compose these with the supplied adjunction and transport the left functor along S.ring.integralLeft. This is integralAdjunction_exists in Lean.

Choose the ordinary tensor presentation aZ from IntegralHom.models_exist. Apply integralDualFormulaComparison to this presentation, the supplied ordinary presentations and signed symmetry, and the integral adjunction from the previous step. Transport along the resulting natural isomorphism; its conclusion supplies FormulaNormalized with the identity component.

Functor.hext, the object equations and the pure-arrow equations at coefficient 1 show that each restricted integral dual commutes with rationalization. The corresponding defining equations for rationalDerivedPullback give the same assertion for pullback. Apply Functor.rightOp and Functor.op and compose to obtain formula_localization. For support, the equality follows from LinearMap.baseChange_tmul at coefficient 1. These are equalities of the specified functors, not unspecified comparison isomorphisms.

Use the existing scalar-localization helpers semilinear_all_shift_linear and semilinear_localization_isLocalization to give both Q functors their categorical localization instances at Rationalization.W. Apply Mathlib CategoryTheory.Adjunction.localization to the integral adjunction and the commuting functor equalities. Mathlib Adjunction.localization_counit_app expresses its counit as two equality transports followed by Q of the integral counit. eqToHom_map and eqToHom_comp_heq remove those transports heterogeneously. This is localizeAdjunction and rationalAdjunction_of_integral in Lean.
Package the rational adjunction, aZ, the transported integral adjunction, its identity normalization and the localized-counit HEq into DualFormulaAdjunctionNormalized.

proof_origin.place: Integral normalized comparison is the separate geometric step. The full-category transport and single-field rational descent are proved directly in Lean using Mathlib localization of adjunctions and its counit formula.

theorem rationalDualFormulaAdjunction_exists
    (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω] [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω]
    (S : System l Ω D hl (f := f)) :
    ∃ adj : sfCompactSupportFiniteFunctor l D.k
        (PurCompactSupport.coefficientPrimeUnit l D hl) c F.carrier ⊣
          dualFormula l X D hl (f := f) F wX wY A B,
      DualFormulaAdjunctionNormalized D l hl X c F wX wY A B adj
